# Breadcrumb

The trail of pages above this one, so people know where they are.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Dense data</span></p>

## When to use it

**In Dense data:** On a record's own page, the way back to the list it came from. Not on the queue itself.

- **Use it when:** Deep structure where people may want to go up a level.
- **Not when:** Steps of a task (progress), or the main navigation.

Instead:

- [Progress](./progress.md): Steps of a task, not where a page sits.
- [Pagination](./pagination.md): Pages of a list, not levels.

## Words

- Lead with the object, then the state: "Alert 2041 contained."
- Use numbers, not words for numbers.
- One verb per button. No "please", no exclamation marks.
- Use: Investigate, Filter, Assign, Escalated, Resolved. Avoid: Oops, Awesome, Please, Simply.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Cancel
- `content.action.destroy`: Delete
- `content.action.retry`: Retry
- `content.action.empty-action`: Change filters

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

Test before you ship:

- [ ] It is a navigation landmark, and the current page is marked as current. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add breadcrumb
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Breadcrumb reads 9 tokens of its own, each an alias of a semantic token. Each row is one part: its own token, the semantic it aliases, and the value it ends at. Change a semantic and every component that reads it follows; override one of Breadcrumb's tokens to change Breadcrumb alone.
